description: A shell script containing tests for 'git reset' with '--merge' and '--keep' options, including setup, various test cases, and expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the following command fails.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path is missing.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_diff
methods.description: Checks differences between files or commits.

methods.name: test_diff --exit-code
methods.description: Checks for differences and expects none.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output or logs.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
